summary.oneLiner: Atlas Cycle (Haryana) Ltd is a bicycle manufacturer undergoing business revival, operating from Sonepat and Sahibabad units.
summary.business: The Company manufactures and sells bicycles in the domestic market. During FY2025-26, it produced 21,838 bicycles and recorded sales of ₹690 lacs, with no export activity. The Company is in the process of business revival.
